steps.en: Run the ID server and the relay on a public host and open their ports
steps.zh: 在有公网地址的主机上跑起 ID 服务器和中继，开放端口

steps.en: On first start, hbbs generates the server key pair
steps.zh: hbbs 首次启动时生成服务器密钥对

steps.en: In each client's Settings → Network, enter your ID server and that public key
steps.zh: 在每台客户端的设置 → 网络里填上你的 ID 服务器和这把公钥

steps.en: Every client registers its ID with your server and keeps a heartbeat
steps.zh: 每台客户端向你的服务器登记 ID 并保持心跳

steps.en: Type the remote machine's ID and password
steps.zh: 输入远端机器的 ID 和密码

steps.en: Brokers a direct hole-punched link, else relays it; streams encrypted screen and input
steps.zh: 撮合一条打洞直连，打不通就走中继；加密传输画面和键鼠

value.en: Remote control across NATs where the broker and the relay are your own servers, not a vendor's cloud
value.zh: 跨 NAT 远程控制，撮合和中继都在你自己的服务器上，不经厂商的云

sources: https://rustdesk.com/docs/en/self-host/rustdesk-server-oss/docker/ (docker run ... rustdesk/rustdesk-server hbbs / hbbr; ports 21115-21119, 21116 TCP+UDP)
https://rustdesk.com/docs/en/self-host/rustdesk-server-oss/ (hbbs = ID, rendezvous and signaling; hbbr = relay when direct P2P is not possible)
https://rustdesk.com/docs/en/self-host/client-configuration/ (Settings → Network: ID, Relay, API, Key; key generated on first run of hbbs in id_ed25519.pub)
https://github.com/rustdesk/rustdesk#readme (use the public rendezvous/relay server or set up your own)
